map.同一笔 50 万欠款，约定固定违约金 2% = 10,000 元；当逾期超过约: On the same ¥500,000 debt, a fixed 2% penalty = ¥10,000; once the delay exceeds about 67 days at 0.03% a day, daily accumulation overtakes the fixed amount, so weigh the two when signing.
map.日违约金 0.05% 折合年化多少？: What does a 0.05% daily penalty annualize to?
map.0.05% × 365 = 18.25%，已超过 LPR 四倍（约 13.8%）: 0.05% × 365 = 18.25%, above the 4× LPR ceiling (about 13.8%); the excess may be reduced in litigation.
map.可以同时主张违约金和逾期利息吗？: Can a penalty and overdue interest be claimed together?
map.通常以填补损失为原则，二者并主张不得超过实际损失合理范围；借贷关系中逾期利息本身: The guiding principle is to make the loss good, so a combined claim must stay within a reasonable range of actual loss. In a lending relationship overdue interest is itself a breach remedy, so stacking requires a contractual basis and remains subject to the cap.
